intro: Island Fastpitch runs Open and C Level tournaments across Long Island through the Fall. Every event is sanctioned and umpired by USSSA, and every one of the dates below is open for registration now.

highlights.title: USSSA umpires
highlights.text: Every tournament is worked by USSSA umpires, so the standard of play and the strike zone are the same from one weekend to the next.

highlights.title: Champions and finalists
highlights.text: Champions take home a championship award, a banner, medals and MVPs. Finalists are recognized with a finalist award and medals.

highlights.title: Game guarantee
highlights.text: Weekend tournaments guarantee four games for every division. One day tournaments guarantee three, with 10U and 12U on Saturdays and 14U and 16U on Sundays.

highlights.title: Open and C Level
highlights.text: Games are played on both turf and dirt. Championship MVP awards may include belts, gold chains and spinner medals.
